summary: Phase 3 chunk 3-1 (work screens) tested on preview against JRN-62..68 and the review-request feature list. Backend (read-only API smokes): GET /bookings/{id}/actions gives correct reasons for every Active and Cancelled booking (80 checked), and for admin, accounts, sales and siteengineer (siteengineer gets 403, as expected). The ledger law (Σ Udhar − Σ Jama = outstanding − advance) holds on 80 of 80 bookings. The Inventory grid counts match the Home 'Inventory by tower' widget for SGH (admin real statuses and sales masked statuses) and for Ye. UI (Playwright): the booking page has exactly 5 tabs. Record payment opens the 5-field sheet with the booking pre-selected. More lists all items. Change plan is disabled with the server reason; Transfer and Cancel are disabled with 'Clear or bounce pending cheques first' on BK-2526-2332. The Change plan dialog opens on BK-2627-2456. The cancelled booking BK-2526-2366 shows VOID, has no Record payment and no Pay refund (no refund is pending), and all its actions are disabled with 'Booking is Cancelled'. The header, Overview balance and Ledger foot agree on BK-2526-2331 and BK-2526-2357. JRN-65 posted ₹10,000 Cash (receipt KKT/2627/26974), saw 'Print / download receipt', the numbers updated, and the reversal restored every number exactly. Customer 360 has exactly 5 tabs. Record payment is the main action for the active-booking customer and New booking for the customer whose only booking is cancelled. More has all items. Legacy ?tab= values all map correctly (ledger, demands, receipts → money; timeline, notes, service → activity; construction → bookings; coapplicants → kyc). Keys 1–5 switch tabs. The project page has 5 tabs; the per-tower grid opens a drawer with price and status; sales sees only Available, Hold and Sold; the Ye hero shows 'No bookings yet'. At 390 px none of the three pages scrolls sideways and the main action is reachable. Night theme renders. Defects found: 9 (1 medium, the rest minor/design).

minor.issue: Counts any non-voided demand with paid_paise>0, including other-charge demands, but the reason text says 'An instalment is already paid'. If a charge bill is paid but no instalment is, the reason is wrong. This rule existed before this chunk (the PLAN_LOCKED handler uses the same query), so this is only a wording mismatch.

Each payment post and reversal is logged twice (entity_type=booking and entity_type=payment), so Customer 360 › Activity shows every payment action twice (seen for KKT/2627/26974). Probably existed before this chunk.

ui_bugs.issue: The cancelled booking BK-2526-2366 shows 'Next bill due ₹4.2 L by 28 Nov 2025 · DM-2526-9357' under the VOID banner while Balance says Settled. Its demands have status 'Cancelled' with voided=false, and nextDue() filters only !voided && status!=='Paid'. Fix: also exclude status 'Cancelled', or hide the card when b.status==='Cancelled'.

'Next bill due' looks only at instalment demands. On BK-2526-2331 it shows Brickwork ₹6.5 L by 25 Nov 2026, but the Club Membership and GST charge bills dated 11 Apr 2025 are still unpaid (₹2,96,575 other charges due). The earliest unpaid bill should be shown, or the charges mentioned too. On BK-2526-2357 the charges text says 'part-paid ₹0 of ₹1.4 L', which is 'unpaid', not part-paid.

ui_bugs.component: BookingMore.jsx ChangePlanDialog (and the BookingDetail hero plan pill)
ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Current plan: —' because it reads b.payment_plan_name, which GET /bookings/{id} never returns. The name is in b.payment_plan_snapshot.name ('Standard CLP'). The plan pill in the hero never shows for the same reason. Fix: use b.payment_plan_snapshot?.name.

ui_bugs.component: BookingParts.jsx MainAction (role without finance.payment.create, e.g. sales@kkt.in)
ui_bugs.issue: Sales sees a greyed-out 'Record payment' main button. The reason appears only as a hover title, so the spec's 'disabled with the server reason shown' is not met on the main button, and touch users never see it. Customer 360 instead falls back to New booking for the same role, so the two pages behave differently. Either hide the button, show the reason visibly, or fall back the same way on both pages.

The hero correctly shows '— / No bookings yet', but the Collections section on the same Overview still shows 8 tiles of ₹0 (Agreement value, Collected, Outstanding cash, account and other charges, Collected this month, Overdue, Pending cheques). This contradicts 'No bookings yet instead of ₹0'. The hero chip also reads '1 towers' (plural).

issues: The flat chips use class 'text-canvas', which is not defined in tailwind.config.js (no colors.canvas), so the chip text inherits the page colour. Light theme: rgb(23,25,30) on green rgb(23,114,74) ≈ 2.9:1. Night theme: rgb(236,237,239) on rgb(69,201,138) ≈ 1.9:1. Both fail WCAG for 11px bold text. Define a canvas/on-status token or pick the text colour per status.

The reason line (text-xs text-txt-muted) sits inside a DropdownMenuItem with data-disabled, which applies opacity-50. The reason is the most important text there, yet it is barely readable in both themes. Keep the reason at full opacity.
Booking › Bills & Receipts stacked cards show bare values (DM-2526-9269 · Booking · 10% · 11 Apr 2025 · 26 Apr 2025) with no field labels.
Customer 360 › Money › receipts-list table stays a table (417 px) inside its card instead of becoming cards.
Customer 360 key-strip tiles wrap '₹41.8 L' and '₹32.4 L' onto two lines next to the sparkline.
The Ledger tab and the C360 Money ledgers still use row labels 'Demand raised', 'Charge demanded' and 'Due raised' (JRN-63 asks for Bill raised / Received / Balance; JRN-70 bans 'demand').
C360 Connected to shows 'kyc_files'; the project checklist shows 'has towers', 'plans assigned', 'pricing set'.
The C360 Overview next-due button says 'Post payment' while the main action says 'Record payment'.
The C360 booking mini card title starts with '· C-102' (empty prefix).

action_items: BookingParts.nextDue: exclude demands with status 'Cancelled' (or hide Next bill due on a cancelled booking); consider including unpaid other-charge bills with earlier due dates.
Use b.payment_plan_snapshot?.name for 'Current plan' in ChangePlanDialog and for the hero plan pill.
InventoryGrid chip text colour: 'text-canvas' does not exist; choose readable text per status in both themes.
Show disabled-reason text at full opacity in the More menu, and decide on the main action for roles without finance.payment.create (show the reason visibly, or hide or fall back as on C360).
Ye / no-bookings project: replace the ₹0 tiles in the Overview › Collections section with the 'No bookings yet' empty state; fix the '1 towers' plural.
Optional: rename the ledger row labels to Bill raised / Received; field labels on mobile stacked cards; C360 receipts table → cards at 390 px; de-duplicate payment audit events in the C360 feed.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingDetail.jsx (906 lines) and Customer360.jsx (931 lines) are still over the 700-line guideline even after extracting BookingMore, BookingParts and C360Actions.

MainAction: rules===null (a failed /actions call) on a cancelled booking renders no main action silently; on an active booking it enables Record payment without the server check. Acceptable, but log the failure.

C360Actions 'Edit customer' goes to /customers/:id/edit (full form) rather than opening the profile editor in Documents & KYC as action_inventory C18 states. It is still reachable, but the inventory row should be corrected.
ChangePlanDialog sends a hard-coded reason 'Changed from booking page' and the default acceptance_mode, so the user cannot enter a reason.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (JRN-62..68 core flows pass; 5 UI bugs + design issues)
